title: Collected Works and Collections
summary: The form subdivision --Collected works was discontinued in early 1988 and must not be used on new headings. The form subdivision --Collections is valid only under nine specific headings: Autographs, Charters, Drama, Fiction, Literature, Manuscripts, Playbills, Poetry, Treaties (and no others may be proposed).
validation_rules: `--Collected works` is discontinued (since early 1988); it is invalid under any heading assigned to a new work. Assign the appropriate headings with no form subdivision instead. (H 1425 Background, sec. 1.a)

[LC practice] Existing bibliographic records with `--Collected works` are not systematically revised, but the subdivision is deleted when a record's headings are revised for other reasons, and post-1980 earlier editions of a newly cataloged edition are updated to match. (H 1425 sec. 1.b, 1.c)

`--Collections` is a form subdivision valid only under these headings: `Autographs`, `Charters`, `Drama`, `Fiction`, `Literature`, `Manuscripts`, `Playbills`, `Poetry`, `Treaties` (e.g. `Poetry--Collections`). It is invalid under any other heading. (H 1425 sec. 2)
Do not propose `--Collections` under any other heading. (H 1425 sec. 2)

sections.heading: a. General rule
sections.text: Do not use the subdivision *--Collected works* under headings assigned to any new work being cataloged. To any work that would formerly have been assigned this subdivision, assign the appropriate headings with no form subdivision.

sections.heading: b. Bibliographic file maintenance
sections.text: LC practice: Do not make any systematic attempt to delete the subdivision from existing bibliographic records. However, if the subject headings on an individual record are being revised or updated for other reasons, delete *--Collected works* at the same time.

sections.heading: c. New editions
sections.text: LC practice: If a new edition of a work is being cataloged, earlier editions of which have been assigned headings with the subdivision *--Collected works*, update records of those earlier editions having imprint dates of 1981 or later, so that the 6XX fields in the records for all post-1980 editions match. Do not update records for editions having an imprint date earlier than 1981.

sections.heading: 2. --Collections
sections.text:
Use the form subdivision *--Collections* only under the following headings, where it has been specifically established:

- *Autographs*
- *Charters*
- *Drama*
- *Fiction*
- *Literature*
- *Manuscripts*
- *Playbills*
- *Poetry*
- *Treaties*

Do not submit proposals to establish this subdivision under any other headings.
